2608.27370.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090
2608.27370.paper_summary: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities. Although strong open-source efforts already exist, including open-weight models and open-source training recipes, a cost-efficient, hardware-accessible, and open-source pretraining recipe has long been missing. Even at a small scale, training Llama-3.2-3B costs over \$1.5M, and reproducing SmolLM3-3B needs over \$700K. In this report, we present an open pretraining recipe designed to lower this barrier. Using this recipe, we train a collection of Puro-2B models from scratch on up to 1.4 trillion tokens with FP8 precision on consumer-grade RTX 5090 GPUs. The models in the collection differ in token budgets and selected recipe variants. Our best model is trained at a compute cost of less than \$6.9K and approaches Qwen2.5-1.5B performance under our evaluation protocol. This cost efficiency is enabled by a combination of approaches, including hardware selection, low-precision training, hyperball optimization, curriculum model averaging, and the data recipe. Beyond the recipe itself, we provide two additional results. First, across the Puro-2B collection, we derive a Puro Cost Scaling Law that relates training cost to average model performance; the fitted law suggests that about \$4.4K, less than \$5,090, is sufficient to reach the performance of Qwen2-1.5B. Second, as an end-to-end case study, we examine how pretraining data curricula shape downstream performance after post-training. Such controlled studies are enabled by having access to the full pretraining pipeline rather than model weights alone. We release the full training recipe for Puro-2B, including data, code, and model weights under Apache 2.0 at https://huggingface.co/collections/thu-pacman/puro-2b.
2608.27370.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型的預訓練幾乎與高昂的成本劃上等號，使其對於大多數學術界和開源社群而言難以觸及。儘管已有強大的開源努力，包括開放權重模型和開源訓練配方，但一個具成本效益、硬體可接觸且開源的預訓練配方長期以來一直缺失。即使在小規模下，訓練 Llama-3.2-3B 的成本超過 150 萬美元，而重現 SmolLM3-3B 需要超過 70 萬美元。在本報告中，我們提出了一個旨在降低這一障礙的開放預訓練配方。使用這個配方，我們在消費級 RTX 5090 GPU 上從零開始訓練了一系列 Puro-2B 模型，處理高達 1.4 兆個標記，並使用 FP8 精度。這些模型在標記預算和選擇的配方變體上有所不同。我們的最佳模型在計算成本低於 6,900 美元的情況下訓練，並在我們的評估協議下接近 Qwen2.5-1.5B 的性能。這種成本效益是通過多種方法的組合實現的，包括硬體選擇、低精度訓練、超球優化、課程模型平均和數據配方。除了配方本身，我們還提供了兩個額外的結果。首先，在 Puro-2B 系列中，我們推導出一個 Puro 成本縮放法則，該法則將訓練成本與平均模型性能相關聯；擬合的法則表明約 4,400 美元，即低於 5,090 美元，足以達到 Qwen2-1.5B 的性能。其次，作為一個端到端的案例研究，我們檢查了預訓練數據課程如何在後訓練後影響下游性能。這樣的控制研究得以實現，因為我們可以訪問完整的預訓練管道，而不僅僅是模型權重。我們釋放了 Puro-2B 的完整訓練配方，包括數據、代碼和模型權重，遵循 Apache 2.0 授權，網址為 https://huggingface.co/collections/thu-pacman/puro-2b。
